description: This file is a script written in JavaScript ES Modules that acts as a command-line utility to run extension batch tests using Vitest. It manages command-line arguments, resolves extension plans, and spawns child processes to execute tests.

methods.name: runVitestBatch
methods.description: Executes a batch of Vitest tests in a child process, handling process exit codes and signals.

methods.name: printUsage
methods.description: Prints usage information and instructions for the command-line utility.

methods.name: parseExtensionIds
methods.description: Parses raw command-line arguments to extract extension IDs and passthrough arguments.

methods.name: run
methods.description: Main async function that processes command-line arguments, plans test runs, and executes them sequentially.
